title: Validate build 9 on the connected physical pair
outcome: Install exact-source WellSpent 0.2.0 (9) through Xcode paired deployment and record feasible nondestructive physical icon, workflow and readiness checks without substituting them for distribution or broader device acceptance.

included: Use the independently verified build9 source and a separate linked physical checkout so Xcode cannot modify frozen CI/archive source.
Read physical phone/Watch readiness, installed version and pairing; preserve installed data while updating through Xcode unified companion deployment.
Run feasible nondestructive icon, app and actual system-surface observations with fictitious records and record configuration, installation channel and owner observations precisely.
Record remaining owner-operated, long-duration, unavailable hardware and distribution requirements explicitly; preserve prior failures and evidence.
excluded: Erase, uninstall, unpair, backup restore, replacement Watch, oldest-build upgrade case and inspection of unrelated personal content.
Automated test suites that reset the production iPhone store; synthetic fixture tests cannot certify real transport or system surfaces.
App Store mutations, public support/privacy edits, tester invitations, legal agreement acceptance, product code or version/signing identity changes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Physical readiness and installed 0.2.0(9) identity are independently recorded; an Xcode paired update preserves existing data and never substitutes independent bundle installs.
Observed physical icon/workflow outcomes are distinguished from owner-operated, unobserved, distribution and broader acceptance gaps.
